To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) accountants are involved to some extent in the sustainability accounting practices of the companies in our sample, but their role differs from company to company, (2) accountants mainly play a gate-keeping function between sustainability managers and top management, (3) this gate-keeping function is based on the accountants’ expertise in accounting and finance, and (4) accountants’ gate-keeping role is supported by their power position within the companies.
accountants play a gate-keeping and controlling role in the sustainability accounting process.
accountants play an important role as gatekeeper between the sustainability department and higher management in companies.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the role of accountancy in the corporate sustainability accounting practice, with the question being whether accountants are gatekeepers of sustainability information and if yes what their role is in this context.
the question of how sustainability accounting practice is organised in leading companies.
the role of accountancy in sustainability accounting and reporting, and the role of accountancies in sustainability accounting and auditing.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
sustainability information is a complex and dynamic phenomenon which is not easily captured in a single framework.
accountants are gatekeepers of sustainability information.
the accountants' involvement in sustainability accounting practice depends on the type and size of the company.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the role of accountant is to be a gatekeeper between sustainability managers and the higher management.
accountants are not yet the main drivers of sustainability reporting but are increasingly becoming involved in sustainability accounting.
accountants are involved to varying extents in corporate sustainability accounting practice.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there are many opportunities for accounting to contribute to sustainability.
accountants play an essential role in sustainability accounting and reporting, which is often neglected in the literature.
the role of accountant in sustainability accounting and reporting is not a given.
